integrity: Source dates and published invariants are distinguished from the new analytical cap law; previously known odd-cycle facets, Gaussian invariance principles and beta-function formulas are credited.
scientific_limitations: Results concern odd cycles and the Euclidean-volume-uniform conditional integrality-violating simplex. title: Antiperiodic Brownian geometry of the odd-cycle integrality cap
